title: Missing index on messages.state_version column
description: MessageStore::get_changes_since() in message.rs queries 'SELECT id FROM messages WHERE state_version > ?'. No index exists on messages.state_version, causing a full table scan on every Message/changes call. Fix: add CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS messages_state_version ON messages(state_version) to SCHEMA_V1 migration and bump to version 2.
